brief:
Israel has developed a contingency plan to respond if Hezbollah moves to support Iran militarily, the Ma'an news agency reported. The strategy outlines potential Israeli operations should the Lebanese militant group take direct action in solidarity with Tehran.

Details of the plan's specific measures were not disclosed. The preparation reflects Israeli concerns about regional escalation amid tensions between Iran and Israel.
title: Israel prepares escalation plan if Hezbollah backs Iran militarily
